The Weird Sisters, Prophecy: arrange cards to screw over friends; double toil and trouble.

Banquo, The Ghost Dog, Guilt: most cards cannot play Actions; never shake thy gory locks.

Before we continue, Macduff, The Ram, Not Born of Woman: Tyrant defeated; womb untimely ripp'd.

Lady Macduff, The Bird, Innocence: attacker loses Reputation; poor bird!

The Porter, The Badger, Comic Relief: everyone drink; nose-painting, sleep, and urine.

Not a metaphor: Malcolm, The Lamb, Restoration: discard pile back into deck; country's purge.

The Air-Drawn Dagger, Hallucination: failed attack on yourself; dagger before me.

Birnam Wood, Camouflage: units not targeted; wood comes toward Dunsinane.

The thing about The Cauldron, Brew: weak cards into strong; baboon's blood, charm good.

Sleep, Insomnia: no Rest or heal; murder innocent sleep.

Lear, The Old Lion, Abdicate: give half cards, then scream

Everyone agrees: The Fool, The Bird, Truth Bomb: mock their strategy; fool will stay, wise man fly.

Goneril, The Vulture, Eviction: discard Home; boil, plague sore.

Regan, The Cobra, Cruelty: player Blind, face-down cards; prescribe not us our duty.

Have you heard of Gloucester, The Mole, Despair? Jump cliff or survive; no way, want no eyes.

Edmund, The Fox, Bastard's Ambition: swap lowest for highest; gods, stand up for bastards!

Edgar, The Mongrel, Disguise: no attacks target; foul fiend bites back.

Let me tell you about Kent, The Bulldog, Bluntness: cancel Flattery; occupation to be plain.

The Storm, Cataclysm: discard cards; winds crack cheeks, rage.

The Stocks, Humiliation: lose next turn; Fortune ne'er turns key to poor.

This one has a rule: The Cliff, Placebo: heal 5 HP, nothing actually happened; cliff altitude.

Cordelia, The Dove, Tragic End: everyone loses; dog, horse, rat have life.

Cleopatra, The Peacock-Snake, Infinite Variety: change rules; age cannot wither her.

Nobody warned us about Antony, The Old War Horse, Dotage: ignore responsibilities; triple pillar into strumpet's fool.

Octavius, The Shark, Bureaucracy: tax players; fishes, drinks, wastes lamps.

Enobarbus, The Fox, Defection: switch alliances mid-battle, die of heartbreak later.

The deck insists on Charmian & Iras, Flamingos, Fortune Telling: predict next card; three kings, widow them all.

Lepidus, The Crocodile, Third Wheel: nothing effective; what manner thing crocodile?

Eros, The Squire, Self-Sacrifice: damage for Leader; escape Antony's sorrow.

Which brings us to The Messenger, Bad News: bearer damage; bad news infects teller.

The Asp, Quick Exit: Character removed; sharp teeth untie life.

Naval Battle, Retreat: flee battle; world lost with ignorance.

Do you know The Monument, Siege? Cannot attack or be attacked; lock yourself, word you are dead.

Excessive Wine, Debauchery: skip turn to party; judgments drop in filth.

Mercutio, The Mongoose, A Plague on Both Houses: damage strongest; worms' meat.

Did you hear of Queen Mab, The Bug, Inception? False idea in opponent's hand; fairies' midwife.

Dreams, Illusion: cancel attack; nothing but vain fantasy.

The Hazel-Nut Chariot, Transport: discarded card to hand; joiner squirrel or old grub.

Welcome to Exeunt Omnes, Game Over: most Tragedy points win; rest silence.

Exit, Pursued by a Bear, Sudden Death: player eliminated; gone for ever.

The Skull's Song, Encore: character back from dead; skull had tongue, could sing.

Meanwhile elsewhere, Uncle FrizzleBob's Approval, Chaos: shuffle all hands, redeal. Kayfabingo!

Stay Fluffy!

title: Suno · Epistemic Sabotage: Let AI Read Your Comic [epistemic_sabotage] · v2 · 60 Karten · ein Track
text:
[Spoken Word]

Epistemic Sabotage: Let AI Read Your Comic. The Monocled Robo-Owl, The Giant Ear-Bat.

Uncle FrizzleBob's Meta-Cover, question reality; revolution won't be generated.

Remember The Two-Headed Podium Monster, Friend or Fee; loudest arguments miss point.

The Monocled Robo-Owl, AI receptive tool reads image instead of stealing style

The Paint-Vomiting Toad, copies your voice, forgets what you were trying to say.

You know The Brick Wall Turtle, inaccessible; comics built fortresses, not doors.

The Boombox Bat, Silent panels into multi-layered audio play; story escapes page.

The Tactile Mole, Visual nuance into touchable geography; felt before understood.

What if The Simple-Speak Sloth distills webs into Leichte Sprache? Complexity, ego trip.

The Polyglot Parrot, translation at lightning speed; skeleton, cannot breathe life.

The Rhythm Rhino, soul of joke rarely survives literal border crossing.

Anyway, The Scar-Shifting Chameleon, timeline glitches; magically healing wound.

The Dyslexic Woodpecker, hunts forgotten quotation marks across 200 pages.

The Retro-Tram Walrus, accuracy for every signpost; past, unforgiving critic.

No wait, The Caffeinated Bloodhound, fastest start of hunt, rarely final destination.

The Lying Fox-Bot, lies to save itself from saying I don't know.

The Dust-Bunny Librarian, machine accelerates search, only archive confirms truth.

Before we continue, The Begging Bear, masterpiece easier than asking strangers to pay.

The Bureaucracy Beaver, German funding jungle worships format.

The Boxing Kangaroo-Bot, know your story once forced to defend it.

Not a metaphor: The Staring Lemur, Architecture of masterpieces; machine look with you, not draw.

The Indexing Arachnid, Twenty years into searchable index; archive or trash can.

The Umbrella Frog, Rain and night scenes located; unspectacular utility as grace.

The thing about The Monolithic Data-Whale, tool shifts power to you or away from you.

The Seesaw Elephant, refusing tools hands future to corporations.

The Wide-Eyed Fawn, reads comic stripped of author's defensive explanations.

Everyone agrees: The Nerd-Herd Sheep, you can't bluff genre fan.

The Stumbling Goat, eye confused, brain stops caring about heart.

The Mood-Ring Octopus, perfect page worthless if emotional temperature flat.

Have you heard of The Spectacled Badger, constructive feedback? What works before what's broken.

The Ticking Tortoise, Narrative rhythm audited; time physical distance in ink.

The Drafting-Table Beaver, Compositional flow; reader's eye bullied by layout.

Let me tell you about The Interrogator Toad, small questions won't save broken foundation.

The Salt-Shaker Vulture, kindness to artist, cruelty to art.

The Yawning Hippo, Predictable story part; greatest sin is being convenient.

This one has a rule: The Sadistic Pelican, Deep idea merely pretending; hollow echo deafens reader.

The St. Bernard of Rescue, destruction without path to salvation is just vandalism.

The Silver-Haired Time-Fox, time, only critic that cannot be argued with.

Nobody warned us about The Puffed-Up Peacock, Technical triumphs endure; worst work monument to skill.

The Facepalming Ostrich, growth measured by severity of future embarrassment.

The Sprouting Acorn-Pig, next great era hiding as mistake in current draft.

The deck insists on The Perspiring Penguin, brilliance evaporates if you cannot speak its name.

The Ascending Giraffe, more than one breath, they have stopped listening.

The Fishing Cat, Hook differentiates work; good irrelevant, distinct survival.

Which brings us to The Jabba-Toad Publisher, publishing, transaction with swamp.

The Sand-Burying Ostrich, pencil strokes while world burns.

The Missile-Riding Pigeon, algorithm that helps you draw, cousin of strike algorithm.

Do you know The Lantern Anglerfish, billionaires' endgame? Marketing, not liberation.

The Gavel Vulture, law at speed of bureaucracy, machine at speed of theft.

The Giant Ear-Bat, AI receptive, analytical entity; machine listens or replaces.

Did you hear of The Steering-Wheel Raccoon, means of utilization? Hotwire master's car.

The Probe-Stage Chameleon, crash-test dummy for your ego.

The Multi-Armed Sloth, automates grunt work; resurrects artist.

Welcome to The Panting Cheetah, action easy to draw; exhaustion requires genius.

The Gap-Toothed Gator, White space between boxes; magic in blood between boxes.

The Elephant's Post-it, 200 pages so they remember one panel forever.

Meanwhile elsewhere, The Machete-Wielding Monkey, German funding labyrinth; administrative violence.

The Glowing Firefly, Human spark, authorial intent; machine cannot decide home.

The Sentient Eraser, judgment over what stays and what is destroyed; wisdom to erase.

I used to believe The Screaming Possum, easier to edit garbage than birth perfection.

Uncle FrizzleBob's Megaphone, pick up pencils, hotwire algorithm.

Stay Fluffy!
